title: PAH-OMC-020 universal finite-cylinder locality envelope
question: Does the frozen OMC-013 radius-two catalog give an explicit fixed-power stabilization threshold for every finite-support cylinder?
finding: Yes conditionally for fixed finite k. For support maximum s_f, the recursively enlarged envelope is bounded by s_f+2k and N_k(f)=max(2,s_f+2k+1) separates it from the successor frontier. Primary 14/14, independent 8/8, hostile 8/8, integrated 4/4 and Lean replay pass.
decision_reason: This is a reusable finite locality extension beyond R-561 and recovers its ell_(0,0) threshold at s_f=0. The power-dependent threshold exposes, rather than closes, the missing uniform summability needed by the ordered semigroup objective.
boundary: PAH-001, PAH-OMC-013, OMC-004, the original comparison map, Gibbs/rate normalization and external stochastic Markov time are unchanged. The statement is conditional on the R-493 one-step identity throughout the enlarged cylinders and is finite fixed-k only.
method: Re-derive the OMC-013 root radius at finite levels 2 through 9.
Enumerate representative finite-support families and compute s_f, s_f+2k and N_k(f) for k=0,...,5.
Check strict separation from the successor frontier and recover the R-561 ell_(0,0) row.
Run independent geometry reconstruction, hostile non-promotion controls, integrated replay and Lean arithmetic/induction checks.
next_action: Obtain one source-authorized common realization and prove a uniform connected-word or factorial tail so that fixed-power identities can be summed without exchanging k and n.
revisit_condition: Reopen when a source-authorized common realization/uniform tail or a parent PAH/OMC-013 byte changes; do not repeat the same finite support table without new input.

reproduction.lean: Set-Location verification/lean; lake env lean Tect/PahOmc020UniversalLocality.lean

verification_summary: PASS_CONDITIONAL finite locality: primary 14/14, independent 8/8, hostile 8/8, integrated 4/4 including Lean.
non_claims: No uniform N(f) works for every power; N_k grows with k.
No full exponential semigroup intertwining, j-before-n or anchored-n convergence, common infinite-volume process or R-512 selection.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang--Mills or TOE conclusion.
Markov time remains external stochastic time only.
